specs.name: maxOfList_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond [x]),
    maxOfList [x] h_precond = x

specs.name: maxOfList_two_first_larger
specs.stmt:
∀ (x y : Nat) (h : x = y) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond [x, y]),
    maxOfList [x, y] h_precond = x

specs.name: maxOfList_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList lst h_precond ∈ lst

specs.name: maxOfList_result_in_list
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    ∃ i, lst.get i = maxOfList lst h_precond

specs.name: maxOfList_upper_bound
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    ∀ x ∈ lst, x = maxOfList lst h_precond

specs.name: maxOfList_ge_head
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    lst.head (by exact h_precond) = maxOfList lst h_precond

specs.name: maxOfList_cons_ge_tail
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond (x :: xs)) (h_xs : maxOfList_precond xs),
    maxOfList (x :: xs) h_precond = maxOfList xs h_xs

specs.name: maxOfList_cons_ge_head
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond (x :: xs)),
    x = maxOfList (x :: xs) h_precond

specs.name: maxOfList_eq_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    (lst.maximum) = some (maxOfList lst h_precond)

specs.name: maxOfList_eq_foldl
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList lst h_precond = lst.foldl Nat.max 0

specs.name: maxOfList_constant_list
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Nat) (n : Nat) (h : n = 0) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond (List.replicate n x)),
    maxOfList (List.replicate n x) h_precond = x

specs.name: maxOfList_append_ge
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (x : Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst) (h_precond2 : maxOfList_precond (lst ++ [x])),
    maxOfList lst h_precond = maxOfList (lst ++ [x]) h_precond2 ∧
    maxOfList (lst ++ [x]) h_precond2 = x

specs.name: maxOfList_perm_eq
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst1 lst2 : List Nat) (h : lst1.Perm lst2)
    (h_precond1 : maxOfList_precond lst1) (h_precond2 : maxOfList_precond lst2),
    maxOfList lst1 h_precond1 = maxOfList lst2 h_precond2

specs.name: maxOfList_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList_postcond lst (maxOfList lst h) h

specs.name: maxOfList_ge_all
specs.stmt: x ≤ maxOfList l h

specs.name: maxOfList_mem
specs.stmt: maxOfList l h ∈ l

specs.name: maxOfList_singleton
specs.stmt: maxOfList [n] h = n

specs.name: maxOfList_uniform
specs.stmt: maxOfList l h = n

specs.name: maxOfList_eq_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList_postcond lst (maxOfList lst h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: maxOfList_eq_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList lst h_precond ∈ lst ∧ ∀ x ∈ lst, x = maxOfList lst h_precond
